results.title: Rill Browser: The browser where Claude Code and Codex work beside you | Product Hunt
results.content:
Rill is my way of removing that code-switching. It's a browser with your Claude Code or Codex working alongside you. When something on a page gives you an idea, you say so right there, and an agent starts on it in the right project. You don't have to spend time looking for the right folder, rephrasing everything you just saw on the web, and you don't switch in and out of work mode. The work goes on with you in the flow.

This matters now more than ever. Agents have shortened the distance between ideas to output near zero. So the bottleneck is capturing the idea at the moment you have it. That moment is nearly always while you're taking something in, and that is what a browser is for. [...] Rill is a free AI-native browser. It's WebKit-based, which means it's native to Mac. And it runs on the Claude Code or Codex plan you already have, so you don't have to buy a new subscription for all of its agentic capabilities.c

How do you keep an idea today when it shows up at the wrong time? [...] Subscribe
